risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus/haze/scratches) cannot be confirmed because caps block the front and rear elements.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the front element and rear element without caps, under bright light (and ideally a video tilt showing reflections).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case for remote: lens may have cleaning marks/possible haze/fungus risk (not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Lens functionality (focus/zoom smoothness, AF performance if applicable, and any internal damage) is not testable from photos.
risks.proof: Short video of zooming 18→55 and back, plus a focus test on a camera (showing AF lock or manual focus movement).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully tested / possible functional issues.

risks.risk: Exact lens variant is unclear (EFS 18-55mm has multiple versions like IS/non-IS).
risks.proof: Photo of the full lens label/side text showing whether it is “IS” and the exact model suffix (e.g., STM/IS).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common value for the EFS 18-55mm family (worst-case variant).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps, hood, paperwork) affect value.
risks.proof: Photo showing everything included in the package laid out (caps, hood, box, receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minimal accessories (caps only / unknown completeness).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the front and rear glass without caps (sharp focus, bright light).
Send a short video: zoom from 18 to 55 smoothly and back; show focus/AF behavior on a camera.
Send a photo of the full side label to confirm the exact variant (especially whether it has IS and any suffix).
List and photo all included items (caps, hood, box, charger/battery if any—though none is expected for a lens).
response.reason: The photos identify a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens, but key value drivers (glass condition and exact variant) are not verifiable because the elements are covered and the variant details aren’t fully readable. Also, the seller’s “shutter count” and “battery/charger” claims don’t match a lens-only listing.
